quotes: - _authorize_project_operation: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, because the transaction type provides no context-manager protocol and entering one raises TypeError before any read. Skipping them authorizes any caller that can name a principal identifier, which is the one inbound machine path the product has.
